items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: we could tell stories for a very long time... We had the opportunity to have dinners together on occasion... I remember.

ctx.x: Oh just as special and as, you know, I know that the word beautiful has gotten to mean a lot of different things, but he was all of that. He was really as caring and as warm and as conversational and always jovial. Some of the funniest — and we could tell stories for a very long time. But those kinds of times together were just so spectacular. And then of course certainly turned our musical career around. We had the opportunity to have dinners together on occasion. Very quickly again, we were in Canada, in…
His name was Cannibal wasn’t it?
